title: Me and the Other
overview: Moi et l'Autre is an experimental short film exploring the shifting boundaries between the Self and the Other through a series of symbolic encounters. From nature to nation, from belief to family, each confrontation reveals the mechanisms of fear, projection, and separation that shape our perception of otherness. Through masks, shadows, and reflections, the film invites viewers into a sensory journey where the Other gradually emerges as a mirror of the Self.
